meaning:
κατ-ευθύνω
[in LXX for כּוּן ni., hi., etc. ;]
to make or keep straight, direct, guide: metaphorically, τ. ὁδόν, 1Th.3:11; τ. πόδας εἰς ὁδὸν εἰρήνης, Luk.1:79; τ. καρδίας εἰς τ. ἀγάπην, 2Th.3:5.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love, and into the perseverance of Christ.
